title: Rig Relay RC Reviewer Golden Path v1
description: Structured golden-path checklist for dogfood operational readiness review. A reviewer follows each step and records pass/fail/blocked. No PROMOTE verdict is possible while any step with blocking_failure_conditions remains in a non-passing state.

golden_path_id.description: Stable identifier for this golden path version.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this golden path was generated.

title.description: Human-readable title for this golden path.

description.description: What this golden path covers and what dogfood readiness means.

overall_status.description: Aggregate status. 'passing' means all blocking steps pass. 'blocked' means at least one blocking step is blocked. 'not_verified' means no reviewer has run the path yet.

reviewer.description: Optional reviewer identity when a human runs the path.

user_goal.description: What the reviewer is trying to accomplish in this step.

command_or_ui_action.description: Exact command or UI action the reviewer performs.

expected_result.description: What the reviewer should observe if the step passes.

evidence_path.description: Path to structured evidence artifact that proves this step was exercised (receipt, screenshot path, log path).

blocking_failure_conditions.description: Specific failure modes that would block PROMOTE. If empty, this step is informational only.

phase_id.description: Release-gate phase this step belongs to.

evidence_paths.description: Paths to all evidence artifacts referenced by steps.
